label: First copy step (input = re-fed first token) when the first token is x/r/h/m/e
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.013% of steps). About 75% of activations and of activation mass fall at step L+1, the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the fed-back first original token and the model outputs original token 1. Almost all of these have first token x (about 44% of mass), r, h, m or e. Rarer firings: on <DEL> itself, on the step before <DEL>, and on late original-phase steps after a u. Precision is very low (under 1%): only a small fraction of sequences that start with these letters fire. Firing is more likely when the sequence contains u (often repeated), when L is 5-7, and when orig(1) is u/2/k/h/j/b/m/p. None of these conditions, alone or combined, gets F1 above about 0.12, so the remaining selectivity is a fine-grained conjunction that was not captured. The feature does not fire at t<3, and it fires almost never at recall_idx 4 or later. Activation magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.24). Coverage of the predicate is similar across activation quartiles, so the predicate does not explain magnitude.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=x (+4.63), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=m (+4.34), orig3=u (+3.23), orig0=h (+3.12), orig4=u (+3.00), phase=2 & in_tok=r (+2.86). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.72), phase=2 & out_tok=u (-2.90), prev3_tok=- (-2.46), in_tok=u (-2.21).
